infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Allow CalSnap AI to access your camera to snap food photos and scan barcodes.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Allow CalSnap AI to access your microphone to record quick voice notes about your meals.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Allow CalSnap AI to access your photo library to select food photos.
infoPlist.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: Allow CalSnap AI to use Face ID to lock and protect your nutrition journal.
